questions.prompt: Which describes y = |2x - 4| - 1 as a transformation of y = |x|?
questions.prompt_markup: Which describes y = |2x - 4| - 1 as a transformation of y = |x|?

choices.text: y = 2|x - 4| - 1: shift right 4, stretch vertically by 2, shift down 1
y = 2|x - 2| - 1: shift right 2, stretch vertically by 2, shift down 1
y = 2|x + 2| - 1: shift left 2, stretch vertically by 2, shift down 1
y = |x - 2| - 1: shift right 2, shift down 1, no vertical stretch

questions.correct_answer: y = 2|x - 2| - 1: shift right 2, stretch vertically by 2, shift down 1
questions.grading_note: |2x - 4| = 2|x - 2|. The others shift by 4, shift the wrong way, or miss the factor 2.

questions.prompt: An absolute value function y = a|x + 1| + 3 has vertex (-1, 3), opens down, and passes through (2, 0). Find a.
questions.prompt_markup: An absolute value function y = a|x + 1| + 3 has vertex (-1, 3), opens down, and passes through (2, 0). Find a.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the value. 0 = a · 3 + 3 gives a = -1 (negative, so it opens down).

questions.prompt: f(x) = -|x + 1| + 3. Find f(1) and f(-1), and decide whether f is even.
questions.prompt_markup: f(x) = -|x + 1| + 3. Find f(1) and f(-1), and decide whether f is even.
questions.grading_note: Form required: all three. An even function has f(-x) = f(x) for every x; f(1) ≠ f(-1).
